reviewed_selected_branch.branch: Sudden decrease in speed with a vehicle immediately to the rear
reviewed_selected_branch.basis: The frozen clause separately names stopping and suddenly decreasing speed. The existing pair requests sudden slowing; stopping remains an open alternative.
reviewed_selected_branch.activation: A vehicle is immediately to the rear at the time of the subject stop or sudden speed decrease.
reviewed_selected_branch.temporal_test: For the sudden-decrease pair, measure the onset of the decrease and verify that an appropriate signal to the immediately rear driver begins before that onset.
reviewed_selected_branch.signal_caveat: The frozen clause does not define a numerical lead time or declare that a brake lamp illuminated only by the same deceleration is prior warning. Brake and hand signals require original source timing and independent appropriateness review.
